Name: Rimmon the Beerothite
Summary: Rimmon the Beerothite was the father of Rechab and Baanah, the captains who murdered Ish-bosheth and were executed by David.
KeyStory: Rimmon's sons became the assassins whose crime ended Saul's house.
RelatedPeople: Rechab, Son of Rimmon; Baanah, Son of Rimmon
LifeLesson: Sons can turn a father's name into a byword for treachery.
